python/bzs/evaluation.py.scope: Scoring, aggregation, source probe import, freeze/run, baseline binding, release and limited quality gates read.

python/bzs/evaluation_format.py.scope: Input/package/label/gate validation, method identity, original golden projection, bounded file IO read.

docs/RELEVANCE_EVALUATION.md.scope: Original scope/metrics/labels/gates documentation read; final projection update reviewed via committed diff.

python/bzs/cli.py.scope: Evaluation freeze/run forwarding of explicit queries_path inspected; no full CLI review.

python/tests/test_evaluation.py.scope: Test declarations and relevant snippets inspected; not executed by this reviewer.

findings.status: root-reproduced issue resolved by author; reviewed final fix
findings.assessment: freeze and run each call verify_golden_projection against supplied original file. Exact file/manifest digest, frozen/version and complete selected non-holdout split projection with field values/order are compared as canonical bytes. Missing original input stays blocked, and a self-reported freeze verification cannot replace run-time validation.

Expected judgments cover the entire fixed query pool. Missing judgments block full metrics; diagnostic subset means are explicitly separate. Failed/missing query execution forces blocking independently of permissive thresholds. All empty/no answered samples and no positive relevance judgments cannot pass the finite quality gate.

Synthetic candidate evidence or incomplete declared human judgments block finite quality status. The program validates externally provided human/reviewer structure and identity bindings only; it does not authenticate real assessor activity.

Prior report raw SHA must be frozen; method/corpus/labels/runtime/environment and system identities bind the comparison. Reordered rank input can differ while fixed pool/IDCG cannot silently shrink. Full source ablation/C++ fusion/holdout/hard-constraint/citation verification are not implemented by this increment.

Full release_gate is always blocked with explicit missing dimensions. The finite fixed-candidate gate is separate from package acceptance, source availability, target-machine performance or truth of labels.

reported_author_evidence_only.source: author message; not independently rerun here

acceptance_scope.preserve_original_golden: 40 queries with original 20 development /15 regression /5 holdout; no file changes made by reviewer

limitations: Read-only review does not establish real human relevance or independent assessor participation.

Checksums and timestamps do not authenticate externally supplied baseline, ranking or human provenance.
